behavior: Test-only access checks against three existing fixed OS namespace categories, three access masks and the original/restricted tokens. No enumeration, object creation, ACL or token changes.
privacy: Only fixed scope/access labels and NTSTATUS values; session IDs, paths and SIDs are not returned. All opened handles must close.
limits: This observes a possible remaining boundary; it does not identify the cause before native results.
The original restricted-child creation, token/Job guards, deadlines and exit assertions are unchanged.
A passing access matrix cannot upgrade a failed child or accept an ordinary account.
